description.zh: 陕北民歌中的山歌类型。两句一节常以上句起兴、下句点明情意，用陕北方言演唱。
description.en: A genre of mountain song from northern Shaanxi. A two-line stanza often opens with an image and turns to the singer’s concern in the second line, sung in local speech.

analysis.zh: 听两句结尾的差异。上句可把元音拖长，第二句收束全节。换词时，旋律骨架可重复，字腔随语气微调。
analysis.en: Compare the ends of the two lines. The first may extend a vowel, while the second closes the stanza. New words can reuse the melodic outline, with articulation adjusted to the text.

description.en: An umbrella term for oral song traditions in Wu-speaking regions. Qingpu field songs were sung in rice-growing settings, with related local traditions in southern Jiangsu and northern Zhejiang.

analysis.zh: 对唱时，留心领唱和应答的交接，以及方言语势如何进入旋律。田间歌唱与舞台改编的速度、伴奏和段落长度可以不同。
analysis.en: In responsive singing, listen for the handoff and how the contours of Wu speech enter the melody. Field singing and staged versions can differ in pace, accompaniment and stanza length.

analysis.en: Separate new words from recurring melody, then compare how filler syllables shape breathing, phrase links and cadences.

description.en: The course uses Cantonese tunes as an example of southern singing. Cantonese song comprises multiple genres, and the marker identifies one centre of Cantonese musical life.

analysis.zh: 听一个短句中各字的音高走向，再听句末拖腔。声调、词义和曲调的关系可随演唱版本变化。
analysis.en: Trace the pitch of each syllable in a short line, then listen to the extended cadence. The relation between lexical tone, meaning and tune can vary by performance.

description.en: The lecture pairs Hubei and Hunan for a comparison of folk song in the middle Yangtze region. Each province has its own range of dialects, communities and performance settings.

description.zh: 陆春龄是上海的江南丝竹传承人。《鹧鸪飞》是他的代表曲之一，选上海是为了听他怎样处理一根竹笛的长音。
description.en: Shanghai was home to Lu Chunling, a silk-and-bamboo musician associated with this solo. Listen for the small changes he makes within a sustained flute note.

analysis.zh: 以笛膜的明亮音色为起点，听长音里的气息、句间换气和手指加花。速度或句幅的变化可以用来辨认段落。
analysis.en: Begin with the membrane’s bright buzz and listen for breath within held tones, breaths between phrases and finger ornaments. Changes in pace or phrase length can mark sections.

analysis.zh: 跟随反复出现的乐句轮廓，比较它每次回归时的音区、弓压和滑音。连弓保留了句子的方向，音头与声尾的变化使重复获得不同表情。课程以此讨论意境与气韵生动。
analysis.en: Follow a recurring phrase and compare its register, bow pressure and slides on each return. Connected bowing sustains the phrase’s direction, while changing attacks and releases give the repetition new inflections. The course uses the piece to discuss yijing and qiyun shengdong.

role.en: City associated with performer Guan Pinghu

period.zh: 《流水》见于1425年琴谱
period.en: Flowing Water appears in tablature from 1425

description.zh: 古琴有七弦。《流水》见于1425年的《神奇秘谱》。管平湖的演奏收入1977年发射的旅行者金唱片，地图标示其活动城市北京。
description.en: The guqin has seven strings. Flowing Water appears in the Shenqi Mipu of 1425. Guan Pinghu’s performance travelled on the Voyager Golden Record in 1977. The marker locates Beijing, where he worked.

analysis.zh: 对照散音、按音和泛音的衰减，听滚拂形成的密集声势如何与较疏的句子交替。停顿让前一句余音仍可被感知。这样的距离感与流动感可从意境理解，也可与课程所谈道家自然观及儒家修身并读。
analysis.en: Compare the decay of open, stopped and harmonic tones. Listen for dense sweeps across the strings alternating with sparser phrases. Pauses let the preceding resonance remain audible. The resulting space and motion invite a reading through yijing, alongside the course’s discussion of Daoist naturalness and Confucian self-cultivation.

uncertainty.zh: 明代琴谱、清代谱本及近现代录音是不同阶段的证据。本站播放器为 Charlie Huang 的 2006 年演奏，旅行者金唱片所载为管平湖的演奏。
uncertainty.en: Ming and Qing tablatures and later recordings document different stages. The in-page player is Charlie Huang’s 2006 performance. The Voyager Golden Record carries Guan Pinghu’s performance.

credit.zh: 录于英国伯明翰。使用1876年《天闻阁琴谱》版本。本站沿用上游转码的 MP3。

course.en: Course repertoire · Chinese Instrumental Solo Music, pp. 14, 21, 23–24, uses Flowing Water to explore the guqin, musical imagery and space. See also Aesthetic Appeal of Traditional Chinese Music, pp. 4–5.

description.zh: 四弦弹拨乐器。唐代长安的标记提供早期乐器图像与交流的历史参照，现代独奏的竖抱和指法在后世逐渐定型。
description.en: A four-string plucked lute. The Chang’an marker gives context for Tang-period depictions and exchange. The upright hold and finger technique of modern solo performance developed over later centuries.

analysis.zh: 先找琵琶单次拨弦的音头，再注意密集指触怎样把旋律连起来。鼓声加入时，比较鼓点和琵琶重音的落点。
analysis.en: Pick out the attack of a single pluck, then listen for closely spaced strokes joining the melody. When the drum enters, compare its accents with the pipa’s.

description.zh: 筝的弦各有可移动的琴码。课程用现代二十一弦筝介绍独奏，潮州标记指向一种地方传承。
description.en: Each zheng string has a movable bridge. The course introduces the solo instrument through the modern twenty-one-string form. Chaozhou marks one regional tradition.

analysis.zh: 辨别右手拨弦产生的音头和左手在码外按弦产生的变音。一个音上的按、颤或回落可决定整句的走向与韵味。
analysis.en: Separate the attack from the right-hand pluck and the pitch change made by pressing the other side of the bridge with the left hand. Pressure, oscillation or release on one note can shape the whole phrase.

description.zh: 江南十番音乐包含地方变体。地图以楚州十番锣鼓为例，舞台听辨可以从鼓、锣、钹的音色分工入手。
description.en: Shifan music has regional variants. The map points to Chuzhou shifan luogu. An entry point for listening is the division of timbre among drums, gongs and cymbals.

analysis.zh: 跟随一个短锣鼓型如何在不同打击乐器间交错。比较合击形成的重音与分击形成的层次，辨认过渡段的速度变化。
analysis.en: Track how a short percussion pattern interlocks across instruments. Compare massed accents with staggered layers and notice tempo changes at transitions.

uncertainty.zh: 起始年份未定，地图以选定地区的传承或活动为参照。
uncertainty.en: The origin year is undetermined. The map uses an associated place of practice or activity.

role.zh: 苏南丝竹传承地
role.en: Silk-and-bamboo practice in southern Jiangsu

period.zh: 明嘉靖至隆庆年间的形成线索
period.en: Early development in the Jiajing–Longqing reigns

description.zh: 流传于上海、苏南及浙西等地的合奏传统。丝竹指弦乐与竹管，常见二胡、笛、琵琶、扬琴等。
description.en: An ensemble tradition of Shanghai, southern Jiangsu and western Zhejiang. Silk and bamboo refers to strings and bamboo winds, with erhu, dizi, pipa and yangqin among common instruments.

analysis.zh: 用不同乐器的落音找出同一骨干旋律。各声部可以在同一拍内使用不同装饰，造成支声织体。听笛子的密集加花与二胡延长的音在下一共同落点重新会合。
analysis.en: Use cadential notes in different parts to trace a shared tune. Players can ornament the same beat differently, producing heterophony. Listen for a busy dizi figure and a longer erhu note meeting again on the next shared arrival.

instruments.en: Erhu, dizi, pipa, yangqin and others

uncertainty.zh: 口传、改编与记录可能分属不同时期。地图用已知关联地点定位。
uncertainty.en: Oral transmission, adaptation and documentation may belong to different periods. The map marks a known association.

role.zh: 珠江三角洲音乐传承地
role.en: Area of Pearl River Delta musical practice

period.zh: 明清之际逐渐萌发
period.en: Early development across the Ming–Qing transition

description.zh: 珠江三角洲的器乐传统。二十世纪的硬弓组合与后来常听到的粤胡、扬琴、秦琴组合展示了音色演变。
description.en: An instrumental tradition of the Pearl River Delta. Twentieth-century hard-bow groups and the familiar combination of yuehu, yangqin and qinqin illustrate changing ensemble sonorities.

analysis.zh: 听粤胡如何用滑音修饰旋律、扬琴如何用短促的击弦音衬托。比较乐句中的短动机重复与切分，以及它们对前进感的作用。
analysis.en: Listen for the yuehu’s slides and the yangqin’s sharply struck contributions. Compare repeated short motives and syncopated accents and how they propel a phrase.

uncertainty.zh: 口传、改编与记录可能分属不同时期。地图用已知关联地点定位。
uncertainty.en: Oral transmission, adaptation and documentation may belong to different periods. The map marks a known association.

role.zh: 现代乐团活动城市之一
role.en: One centre of modern orchestral activity

period.zh: 20世纪二三十年代已有新型民族乐团的探索
period.en: New Chinese orchestral forms were explored in the 1920s–1930s

description.zh: 现代民族乐团把吹管、拉弦、弹拨、打击组织为可分组的大型编制。上海标示近现代乐团活动地点之一。
description.en: The modern Chinese orchestra organizes winds, bowed strings, plucked strings and percussion into sections. Shanghai marks one centre of modern ensemble activity.

analysis.zh: 听旋律如何在不同组间转移，并对照齐奏、和声衬托与独奏突出的段落。与小型丝竹相比，大型编制常以配器与声部调度来塑造音响。
analysis.en: Follow the tune as it passes between sections, comparing unison, harmonic support and featured solos. Alongside small sizhu groups, the orchestra shows how scoring and sectional balance shape sound on a larger scale.

instruments.zh: 吹管、拉弦、弹拨、打击乐四组
instruments.en: Wind, bowed string, plucked string and percussion sections

uncertainty.zh: 这里标的是民国时期的大同乐会等探索。新中国成立后，各地又陆续组建专业民族乐团。
uncertainty.en: The dates mark early experiments such as the Datong Music Society during the Republic. Professional orchestras were subsequently established across China after 1949.

role.zh: 快板书活动地
role.en: City associated with modern kuaibanshu

period.zh: 起源年代待考
period.en: Origin date undetermined

description.zh: 以竹板给说唱打出节奏的曲艺。地图标示现代快板书发展相关的北方城市。
description.en: A narrative form in which bamboo clappers articulate the rhythm of delivery. The marker shows a northern city associated with modern kuaibanshu.

analysis.zh: 把重拍板、较轻的眼与口语句首分开听。演员可提前、正踩或延后进入，借停顿或节奏加密安排包袱。
analysis.en: Listen separately to accented ban, lighter yan and the start of a spoken line. An early, aligned or delayed entry, a pause or a rush of syllables can prepare a punchline.

instruments.en: Voice, large and small bamboo clappers

uncertainty.zh: 天津是李少杰从艺和李派快板书传承的城市。节目于2018年公开，原场录制日期和地点待核。
uncertainty.en: Tianjin is associated with Li Shaojie’s career and the Li school of clapper storytelling. CCTV published the clip in 2018. The recording date and venue remain unverified.

course.zh: 课堂曲种 · 《中国说唱音乐》第9、17–21页介绍快板、板眼和句头。《看病》为李派快板书补充试听。
course.en: Course genre · Chinese Narrative Singing, pp. 9 and 17–21, covers kuaiban, accented beats and the start of a spoken line. Seeing the Doctor is a supplementary Li-school performance.

people.en: Li Shaojie

title.en: Seeing the Doctor · Li-school clapper storytelling

credit.zh: 李少杰表演。央视戏曲频道《一鸣惊人》，2018年8月24日发布。
credit.en: Performed by Li Shaojie. CCTV-11 published the Yi Ming Jing Ren clip on 24 August 2018.

prompt.zh: 先听竹板，再跟一句说词。字越说越密时，你还能拍出刚才的板点吗？
prompt.en: Listen to the clappers first, then follow a spoken line. Can you tap the same beat as more syllables fit between strokes?

role.zh: 京音鼓曲演出和传承地
role.en: Centre for performance and transmission of Beijing drum song

period.zh: 清末民初逐步成形
period.en: Formed around the late Qing and early Republic

description.zh: 以京音说唱的鼓曲。书鼓、板和三弦、四胡等形成有层次的伴奏，骆玉笙是课程介绍的演唱家。
description.en: A drum-song genre using Beijing speech. Drum and clappers combine with strings such as sanxian and sihu. The lecture introduces singer Luo Yusheng.

analysis.zh: 听长拖腔如何在句尾收回叙事，以及鼓点如何给段落加标点。伴奏可随字腔衔接、托住或回应唱句。
analysis.en: Listen for drawn-out cadences returning to the story and drum accents punctuating sections. Strings can connect, sustain or respond to sung phrases.

instruments.zh: 人声、书鼓、板、三弦、四胡等
instruments.en: Voice, story drum, clappers, sanxian, sihu and others

uncertainty.zh: 地图以清末民初曲种的形成与流传为时间依据，北京为传承地。试听采用骆玉笙1988年的录音，原录音地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The map follows the emergence of the genre in the late Qing and early Republic and marks Beijing as a centre of practice. The 1988 recording by Luo Yusheng has no confirmed recording location.

people.en: Luo Yusheng

course.zh: 课堂曲种 · Chinese Narrative Singing，第10页介绍京韵大鼓和骆玉笙。《丑末寅初》为补充试听。
course.en: Course genre · Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 10, introduces Jingyun dagu and Luo Yusheng. Chou Mo Yin Chu is a supplementary listening example.

title.en: Chou Mo Yin Chu, sung by Luo Yusheng

credit.zh: 骆玉笙1988年录音，本人配像。央视戏曲频道《中国京剧音配像精粹》于2017年3月25日播出。
credit.en: Luo Yusheng appears on screen to her own 1988 recording. CCTV-11 broadcast this version on 25 March 2017.

prompt.zh: 跟着骆玉笙唱完一句，听听哪个字被拖长了。鼓板在长音里或收尾时落在哪里？
prompt.en: Follow one sung line. Which syllable does Luo Yusheng stretch, and where do the drum and clappers fall as she sustains or releases it?

role.zh: 陕北说书传承地
role.en: Area of northern Shaanxi storytelling

period.zh: 20世纪三四十年代已有重要改造，发源年份待考
period.en: Substantially reworked in the 1930s–1940s, exact origin undetermined

description.zh: 陕北方言的说书传统，历史上有盲艺人走村串户演出。说书人可自弹三弦。
description.en: A storytelling tradition in northern Shaanxi speech. Blind itinerant performers historically travelled between villages. A storyteller may accompany themself on sanxian.

analysis.zh: 留心说白转为有音高的唱句时，拨弦和拍击怎样接管节拍。人物对话、讲述和评议可在相邻句中转换。
analysis.en: Notice how plucking and clapper strokes take up the pulse as spoken delivery turns into pitched song. Dialogue, narration and commentary can switch in adjacent lines.

uncertainty.zh: 榆林是曲种流布地，时间轴标示20世纪三四十年代的表演形式改造。所选《大闹天宫》版本的编创年代、录制地点待核。
uncertainty.en: Yulin is an area of practice. The timeline marks changes to the genre’s performance practice in the 1930s and 1940s. The date of this arrangement of Havoc in Heaven and its recording location remain unconfirmed.

course.zh: 课堂曲种 · Chinese Narrative Singing，第11页介绍陕北说书和三弦自伴。《大闹天宫》为补充试听。
course.en: Course genre · Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 11, introduces Shaanbei storytelling and sanxian self-accompaniment. Havoc in Heaven is a supplementary example.

title.zh: 熊竹英陕北说书《大闹天宫》
title.en: Havoc in Heaven, performed by Xiong Zhuying

credit.zh: 陕北说书《大闹天宫》，熊竹英自弹三弦说唱。央视综艺频道《一笑一周》节目页发布于2024年12月25日。
credit.en: Xiong Zhuying accompanies himself on sanxian in this Shaanbei telling of Havoc in Heaven. CCTV-3 published the segment on 25 December 2024.

prompt.zh: 听熊竹英讲孙大圣，留意唱词停下来的短空隙。右手的三弦在这时怎样接下去？
prompt.en: As Xiong Zhuying tells the Monkey King’s story, listen to a brief gap between his words. How does his plucking hand carry the phrase forward?

excerpt.zh: 央视原片 00:09–00:47。从孙大圣出场的唱句听到镜头转向弹奏三弦的右手。
excerpt.en: CCTV source, 00:09–00:47. From the sung introduction of the Monkey King to the close-up of the plucking hand.

role.zh: 泉州南音传承地
role.en: Centre of Quanzhou Nanyin practice

period.zh: 曲目保留宋元时期的线索，成形时间待考
period.en: Song and Yuan repertory connections, formation date undetermined

description.zh: 闽南语演唱与器乐共存的泉州传统。典型组合用横抱琵琶、洞箫、二弦、三弦与拍板。
description.en: A Quanzhou tradition combining Minnan singing and instrumental repertories. A characteristic lineup includes horizontally held pipa, dongxiao, erxian, sanxian and clappers.

analysis.zh: 听声乐延长字音时箫与弦乐怎样呼应，以及拍板如何在舒缓节奏中定下位置。课程从说唱切入，南音还包含器乐谱套。
analysis.en: Listen for the flute and strings around extended sung syllables and the clappers marking positions in a spacious rhythm. The course approaches Nanyin through sung narrative, alongside an instrumental suite repertory.

instruments.zh: 人声、琵琶、洞箫、二弦、三弦、拍板
instruments.en: Voice, pipa, dongxiao, erxian, sanxian and clappers

uncertainty.zh: 南宋与元代的材料为追溯曲目流传提供线索。本点在南宋年代带展示，曲种何时形成待考。
uncertainty.en: Southern Song and Yuan sources provide evidence of early transmission. This point appears in the Southern Song band. The date of formation remains uncertain.

role.zh: 书场演出与传承地
role.en: Centre for story-hall performance and transmission

period.zh: 评话至迟于明末清初形成，评弹清中期兴盛
period.en: Pinghua formed by the late Ming–early Qing, with pingtan flourishing in the mid-Qing

description.zh: 评弹合称苏州评话与苏州弹词。书场中可连日讲述长篇，苏州方言、角色口吻与曲调共同组织情节。
description.en: Pingtan is the collective name for Suzhou pinghua storytelling and Suzhou tanci balladry. Story halls can present long works in instalments. Suzhou speech, character voices and tunes shape the story.

analysis.zh: 在弹词中听说、噱、弹、唱的切换。三弦或琵琶能交代进入唱段的节拍，也能在叙述停顿处留下余地。
analysis.en: In tanci, listen for shifts among narration, humour, playing and singing. Sanxian or pipa can set the pulse of a sung passage and leave space where narration pauses.

uncertainty.zh: 采用清代发展线索作为此点的时标。苏州评话的早期线索可追溯到明末清初。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks Qing-period development. Early Suzhou storytelling is documented around the Ming–Qing transition.

role.zh: 昆曲发展及传承区域
role.en: Region of Kunqu development and transmission

period.zh: 昆山腔于元末明初形成
period.en: Kunshan vocal style formed in the late Yuan and early Ming

description.zh: 昆山及周边戏曲传统在明代发展。汤显祖1598年写成《牡丹亭》，剧本后来成为昆曲重要剧目。
description.en: The theatrical tradition associated with Kunshan developed in the Ming. Tang Xianzu completed The Peony Pavilion in 1598, and it became a central work in the Kunqu repertory.

analysis.zh: 曲牌提供唱词和旋律的组织框架。听笛子贴着唱句走时，吐字、装饰与拖腔如何相互配合。旦角的眼神、手势和步法也可与乐句长短一并观察。
analysis.en: Tune patterns, or qupai, organize text and melody. Listen for the flute close to the vocal line as diction, ornaments and sustained endings interact. Compare the gaze, gestures and steps of a dan-role performer with the timing of phrases.

instruments.zh: 人声、笛、鼓板及其他伴奏乐器
instruments.en: Voice, dizi, drum, clappers and other accompaniment

uncertainty.zh: 口传、改编与记录可能分属不同时期。地图用已知关联地点定位。
uncertainty.en: Oral transmission, adaptation and documentation may belong to different periods. The map marks a known association.

people.en: Tang Xianzu

role.zh: 戏班交流及演出中心
role.en: Centre of troupe exchange and performance

period.zh: 约19世纪中叶成形
period.en: Formed around the mid-19th century

description.zh: 京剧在北京由多种声腔与表演实践逐渐汇合发展。1790年三庆徽班入京是其中一个有记录的节点。
description.en: Peking opera emerged in Beijing as several vocal and performance traditions converged. The arrival of the Sanqing Anhui troupe in 1790 is one documented milestone.

analysis.zh: 谭孝曾唱诸葛亮的老生唱段“我本是卧龙岗散淡的人”。剧本将开句列为西皮慢板。听京胡的前奏，再听唱腔拉长时，琴声怎样伴着一个字往下走。
analysis.en: Tan Xiaozeng sings Zhuge Liang’s laosheng (older male role) aria. The script marks the opening line as xipi manban, the slow metre of xipi. Follow the jinghu prelude, then listen for the bow continuing through a sustained syllable.

instruments.zh: 人声、京胡、月琴、鼓板、锣等
instruments.en: Voice, jinghu, yueqin, drum, clappers, gongs and others

uncertainty.zh: 地图标记京剧在北京形成的大致时段；所听为“大乐同和”音乐会上清唱的《空城计》选段，央视于2024年10月13日发布。
uncertainty.en: The map dates the emergence of Peking opera in Beijing. The recording features a concert rendition from Da Yue Tong He, published by CCTV on 13 October 2024.

course.zh: 课堂剧种 · 《导论》第8页列课程安排，第17页以京剧举例。《空城计》为补充试听。
course.en: Course genre · Introduction, p. 8 outlines the course and p. 17 gives a Peking opera example. The Empty City Stratagem is supplementary listening.

people.zh: 谭孝曾（演唱）、赵旭（京胡）、刘洋（司鼓）
people.en: Tan Xiaozeng (voice), Zhao Xu (jinghu) and Liu Yang (drum)

title.zh: 《空城计》选段 · 我本是卧龙岗散淡的人
title.en: The Empty City Stratagem · I Was a Recluse at Wolong Ridge

performer.zh: 谭孝曾（演唱）、赵旭（京胡）、刘洋（司鼓）
performer.en: Tan Xiaozeng (voice), Zhao Xu (jinghu) and Liu Yang (drum)

credit.zh: 北京京剧院主办的赵旭京胡专场，2023年10月28日于北京长安大戏院举行。谭孝曾演唱，赵旭操琴，刘洋司鼓。央视《CCTV空中剧院》发布。
credit.en: Beijing Jingju Theatre Company presented Zhao Xu’s concert at Beijing’s Chang’an Grand Theatre on 28 October 2023. Tan Xiaozeng sings with Zhao Xu on jinghu and Liu Yang on drum. Published by CCTV Opera Theatre.

excerpt.zh: 央视单段节目 00:00–06:00.44，含京胡前奏。
excerpt.en: Full CCTV excerpt, 00:00–06:00.44, including the jinghu prelude.

prompt.zh: 开头先听赵旭的京胡。谭孝曾起唱后，哪一个字拖得最开？京胡在这个字收音前做了什么？
prompt.en: Listen first to Zhao Xu’s jinghu. Once Tan Xiaozeng enters, which syllable does he stretch out, and what does the bow do before the voice releases it?

title.en: Bells of Marquis Yi of Zeng

role.zh: 考古出土地
role.en: Archaeological findspot

period.zh: 约公元前433年
period.en: Around 433 BCE

description.zh: 曾侯乙墓出土的成组青铜编钟，为战国早期乐器、音律与礼仪实践留下物证。
description.en: The graduated bronze bells from the tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng document instruments, tuning and ritual practice in the early Warring States.

analysis.zh: 敲击同一钟的不同部位可以发出两个音高，往往相隔三度。把钟作为整套乐器来看，音区和音阶由多枚钟共同构成。
analysis.en: Striking different points on the same bell can produce two pitches, often a third apart. The full set distributes its range and pitch collection across many bells.

instruments.zh: 青铜编钟，墓中另出土弦乐器、管乐器和鼓
instruments.en: Bronze bells, with strings, winds and drums also found in the tomb

uncertainty.zh: 约公元前433年为墓葬年代参照。器物可提示音响与编制，具体演奏曲目仍待考。
uncertainty.en: The burial is dated to around 433 BCE. Objects reveal possible sounds and ensemble resources. The specific repertory remains uncertain.

role.zh: 旋律采集地区
role.en: Area where the source melody was collected

period.zh: 1942年，何仿在六合采集《鲜花调》。1957年整理改词为《茉莉花》。试听采用2022年央视播出版。
period.en: He Fang collected the Flower Tune in Liuhe in 1942 and reworked the lyrics as Jasmine Flower in 1957. The selected version was broadcast by CCTV in 2022.

description.zh: 同名《茉莉花》在不同地方有不同唱法。六合点对应何仿采集《鲜花调》的地区。试听采用李娜演唱的江苏民歌版本，留意反复句的尾音。
description.en: Different regions sing their own Jasmine Flower. Liuhe marks the area where He Fang collected the Flower Tune. Listen to the ends of repeated lines in Li Na’s rendition of the Jiangsu song.

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展，《3 Chinese Folk Song》第 11–12 页介绍东部民歌；该曲为补充的江苏例子。
course.en: Extension of a genre or instrument covered in class

credit.zh: 李娜。央视网2022年公开节目。
credit.en: Li Na. CCTV public programme, 2022.

prompt.zh: 跟着哼出一句，下一句听着相似时，尾音落到同一处了吗？
prompt.en: Hum one line. When a similar one follows, does it end on the same note?

uncertainty.zh: 本条时间标记指向何仿采集《鲜花调》。所选录音的年代另见版本说明。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks He Fang’s collection of the local source tune. The period note separately identifies the selected recording or broadcast.

analysis.zh: 听重复句的尾音，可以辨出同一旋律在两句之间的变化。
analysis.en: Compare cadences to hear small differences between repeated phrases.

people.en: Li Na

role.zh: 江南丝竹传承地
role.en: Local centre of silk-and-bamboo music

period.zh: 传统曲调，成曲年份待考。
period.en: Traditional piece, date of formation undetermined.

description.zh: 《中花六板》是江南丝竹代表曲目，地图标在太仓的江南丝竹传承地。试听采用与日内瓦高等音乐学院相关的丝竹合奏项目所发布的演出。
description.en: Zhonghua Liuban is part of the core Jiangnan silk-and-bamboo repertoire. The map marks Taicang as a place of transmission. The listening version was published by the HEM Geneva silk-and-bamboo project.

instruments.zh: 丝竹乐中的弦乐与竹管

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展，《6 Chinese Instrumental Ensemble》第 11、15 页介绍江南丝竹。

description.en: Yue opera grew out of sung storytelling around present-day Shengzhou. On their farewell walk, Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai carry on their conversation in song.

analysis.zh: 分开听曲调轮廓和方言唱词。比较句尾的音高和时值，辨认反复使用的旋律材料。

role.en: Place of circulation and arrangement of the Liuliu tune

period.zh: 20世纪三四十年代在康定城乡传唱，后来整理为《康定情歌》。
period.en: Widely sung around Kangding in the 1930s and 1940s and later arranged as Kangding Love Song.

description.zh: 《康定情歌》与康定城北、雅拉沟一带传唱的溜溜调有联系。20世纪三四十年代，该调已在康定城乡传唱，后来经整理以现名传播。
description.en: Kangding Love Song is related to the Liuliu tune sung north of Kangding and in the Yala valley. It circulated locally in the 1930s and 1940s and was later arranged under its current title.

analysis.zh: 对照相同位置的衬字和有语义的唱词，体会短小的旋律如何容纳不同字数。
analysis.en: Compare vocables and meaningful words in corresponding places. Notice how a short tune accommodates lines of different lengths.

instruments.en: Voices in a televised stage version

credit.en: Yun Duo and Yu He; CCTV broadcast, 2016.

prompt.zh: 跟听前两句的溜溜衬字。它们出现在相近的节拍位置吗？
prompt.en: Follow the liuliu syllables in the first two lines. Do they come at similar points in the beat?

role.zh: 川剧传承重镇之一
role.en: One of the centres of Sichuan opera

period.zh: 川剧传统剧目，本站所选折子的早期演出年份待考。
period.en: Traditional Sichuan opera repertory; early performance dates for this excerpt are undetermined.

description.zh: 《秋江》以乘舟相追为戏剧情境。成都属于川剧传统的主要传承地之一。这一版本可结合表演动作听一句唱腔怎样收束。
description.en: Autumn River depicts a pursuit by boat. Chengdu is a major centre of Sichuan opera. This version provides a chance to compare the end of a vocal phrase with a stage gesture.

analysis.zh: 把动作分句和音乐分句对应起来。若听到锣鼓点，观察它出现在起唱、收腔还是动作变换处。
analysis.en: Pair the movement phrases with the vocal phrases. Where percussion is audible, note whether it marks an entrance, a cadence or a change of gesture.

uncertainty.zh: 时间待考指《秋江》选段，川剧声腔的历史另见中国非遗网。
uncertainty.en: The date is undetermined for the Autumn River excerpt. The ICH entry describes the broader history of Sichuan opera.

people.en: Liu Ping

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 地方音乐试听。
course.en: Supplementary listening · Regional music.

credit.zh: 刘萍；央视网 2011 年播出。
credit.en: Liu Ping; CCTV broadcast, 2011.

prompt.zh: 选一次明显的手势或脚步变化。唱腔是在动作之前、同时还是之后收住？
prompt.en: Choose a distinct gesture or footstep. Does the voice come to rest before, with or after it?

role.zh: 船工曹光裕入行的码头
role.en: Wharf where Cao Guangyu began his working life as a boatman

period.zh: 1981年，曹光裕在朝天门进入重庆轮渡公司当船工。
period.en: In 1981 Cao Guangyu began working as a ferryman at Chaotianmen.

description.zh: 川江船工以领唱和应和来协调劳动。曹光裕1981年从重庆朝天门码头入行，这一地点有助于理解选段和船工生活的联系。试听来自他在2025年非遗晚会的演出。
description.en: Chuanjiang boatmen used calls and responses to coordinate their work. Cao Guangyu began working from Chongqing’s Chaotianmen wharf in 1981. The audio comes from his 2025 heritage gala performance.

analysis.zh: 把领句和应句记成一组，辨认共同的重拍，想象它怎样提示一船人同时出力。
analysis.en: Mark the call and answer as a unit and identify the shared accent. Consider how it would cue a crew to exert effort together.

prompt.en: Listen to the response after the call. Does it enter after the lead’s final note or overlap it?

title.en: On the Far Side of the Water · Monochord

role.zh: 京族独弦琴传承地
role.en: Place of transmission of the Jing monochord

period.zh: 传统独弦琴与现代歌曲的结合，央视于2020年播出所选版本。
period.en: A modern song on the traditional monochord. CCTV broadcast this version in 2020.

description.zh: 京族独弦琴主要在广西东兴一带传承。这里把东兴作为乐器传统的地点，试听采用雷滢以独弦琴演绎现代歌曲的版本。
description.en: Dongxing is a centre of Jing monochord practice. The map marks the instrument’s tradition. The selected version uses the monochord in Lei Ying’s performance of a modern song.

analysis.zh: 对照语言的语调和琴弦的滑音，留意两者的停顿以及音高连贯方式。
analysis.en: Compare the contour of the spoken voice with the string’s glides. Listen for pauses and how each connects pitches.

uncertainty.zh: 2020年是所选舞台版的播出时间。地图指向乐器的传承地。
uncertainty.en: The year dates the selected broadcast. The map locates the instrument tradition.

prompt.zh: 从朗诵声里辨出琴的第一次出声。听它怎样由一个音滑向下一个音。
prompt.en: Identify the first sound of the monochord against the recitation. Listen to how it slides from one pitch to the next.

role.zh: 剧目早期演出与电影改编的城市
role.en: City of early stage and film versions

period.zh: 1959年，香港推出粤剧电影《帝女花》。
period.en: The Cantonese opera film Princess Changping was released in Hong Kong in 1959.

description.zh: 《帝女花》在香港发展出粤剧舞台和电影版本，香港电影资料馆记载电影于1959年推出。所选声音来自曾小敏、刘建科的舞台片段，两种版本的时间分别列出。
description.en: Hong Kong produced stage and film versions of Princess Changping. The Hong Kong Film Archive dates the film to 1959. Zeng Xiaomin and Liu Jianke perform the later stage extract heard here.

analysis.zh: 比较两位演唱者的音区、字头和句尾。注意伴奏是在唱声停顿处补入，还是与唱腔同时行进。
analysis.en: Compare register, syllable attacks and endings. Listen for whether the accompaniment fills gaps or moves alongside the vocal line.

instruments.en: Cantonese opera voices and stage accompaniment

uncertainty.zh: 1959年指香港电影版，试听为另一版舞台片段。
uncertainty.en: The 1959 date refers to the Hong Kong film. Listening uses a later stage excerpt.

people.zh: 唐涤生（编剧）；曾小敏、刘建科（所选舞台版本）
people.en: Tong Tik-sang, playwright; Zeng Xiaomin and Liu Jianke, performers.

prompt.en: Listen to one exchange between the two characters. Which line ends with more pitch movement?

role.zh: 作品标题所指的地标
role.en: Landmark named in the title

period.zh: 现代作品，央视于2020年播出所选版本。
period.en: Contemporary piece. CCTV broadcast the selected performance in 2020.

description.zh: 曲名所指为澳门东望洋灯塔。澳门海事博物馆记录了灯塔的沿革，地图以该地标说明作品的题材。2020年央视播出所选合奏。
description.en: The title refers to Macao’s Guia Lighthouse. The Maritime Museum documents the landmark’s history. The map marks the subject of the piece, and CCTV broadcast this performance in 2020.

analysis.zh: 从声部进入的先后和主旋律音色入手，辨认合奏里前景与伴奏的变化。
analysis.en: Follow the order and timbre of the instrumental entrances to distinguish melody from accompaniment.

instruments.zh: 器乐合奏，节目页面未逐一列乐器
instruments.en: Instrumental ensemble; individual instruments are not listed on the programme page

uncertainty.zh: 创作时间待考。历史资料中的1865年是灯塔启用时间。
uncertainty.en: The composition date is undetermined. The lighthouse began operation in 1865.

prompt.en: Identify the first complete melody. After it ends, do the other instruments repeat it or bring in different material?

role.zh: 藏戏在拉萨的传承和演出地
role.en: A performance and transmission centre for Tibetan opera

period.zh: 传统戏剧，试听采用2009年公布的申报资料片。
period.en: Traditional opera. The listening selection uses a film published with the 2009 nomination.

description.zh: 拉萨是藏戏的演出和传承中心之一。联合国教科文组织的申报资料片呈现了不同表演场景，选片用来说明唱、舞、叙事和锣鼓怎样组成一段表演。
description.en: Lhasa is a centre of Tibetan opera performance and transmission. The UNESCO nomination film presents different settings and illustrates how song, dance, narration and percussion combine.

analysis.zh: 先跟鼓和钹的重音，再对照身体动作的起落。鼓钹也可用来辨认一个段落的开始或结束。
analysis.en: Follow the percussion accents and compare them with the changes of movement. The percussion can also help identify the starts and endings of sections.

uncertainty.zh: 原页提供资料片，具体录制年份和表演者名单待核。
uncertainty.en: The film is available from its publisher. The footage dates and full cast remain unconfirmed.

people.en: Tibetan opera performers in the nomination film, individually uncredited

credit.en: Published on UNESCO’s official channel. Segment-level performers are uncredited.

prompt.zh: 找到片中一段连续的舞台表演。鼓钹起奏时，演员的步伐或队形发生了什么变化？
prompt.en: Find an uninterrupted performance segment. When drums and cymbals enter, what changes in the performers’ steps or formation?

excerpt.en: UNESCO documentary, about 10:05. Listen to the first complete performance passage.

role.zh: 四川清音传承地
role.en: A centre of Sichuan qingyin performance

period.zh: 四川清音传统曲目，起始时间待考。
period.en: Traditional piece in the Sichuan qingyin repertory, date undetermined.

description.zh: 四川清音以四川方言演唱，是本区说唱音乐传统。《小放风筝》以日常活动为题，选听梁家碧在央视播出的演唱，可以结合课程中讨论的方言与行腔来分析。
description.en: Sichuan qingyin is a regional narrative-song tradition sung in Sichuan speech. Liang Jiabi’s televised performance of Flying a Kite illustrates the interaction of dialect and melodic delivery discussed in class.

analysis.zh: 先听唱词的重音，再听衬腔如何补在它的前后。结合四川方言，比较说话和歌唱的节奏。
analysis.en: First hear the language accents, then notice how flourishes surround them. Compare spoken and sung rhythm in Sichuan speech.

instruments.zh: 人声及曲艺伴奏，四川清音传统节奏乐器有竹鼓和板。
instruments.en: Voice and quyi accompaniment. Traditional rhythm instruments include a bamboo drum and clappers.

uncertainty.zh: 乐种史料与曲目的形成时间分别核对。央视版本为2024年播出。
uncertainty.en: The history of the genre and the date of this piece are separate. CCTV broadcast the selected version in 2024.

people.zh: 梁家碧（所选版本演唱）；四川清音有关资料见中国非遗网
people.en: Liang Jiabi, singer; further documentation is available from China ICH.

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展 · Chinese Narrative Singing，第3页比较南北说唱的语言与地方背景。
course.en: Course extension · Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 3, on regional and linguistic differences.

credit.zh: 梁家碧演唱；央视网2024年播出。
credit.en: Liang Jiabi; CCTV broadcast, 2024.

prompt.zh: 听梁家碧把一个字延长成一串小音的地方。音在变动时，字头和字尾还能听清吗？
prompt.en: Find a place where Liang Jiabi carries one syllable through several notes. Can you still hear where the syllable begins and ends?

role.zh: 何氏创作与工尺谱发现地
role.en: Centre of the He family’s music and place where the score was found

period.zh: 20世纪二三十年代，沙湾何氏广东音乐广泛传播。现存《赛龙夺锦》手稿于2004年发现。
period.en: The He family’s Shawan repertory circulated widely in the 1920s and 1930s. The surviving manuscript was found in 2004.

description.zh: 何柳堂据沙湾龙舟音乐材料反复整理《赛龙夺锦》。所选为珠海民族管弦乐团的演出，能听到龙舟鼓点如何进入乐队织体。
description.en: He Liutang developed the piece from Shawan dragon-boat music. The Zhuhai Chinese Orchestra version shows how boat-race rhythms enter an orchestral texture.

analysis.zh: 比较引子与齐奏段的音响。以反复出现的打击乐型为线索，辨认旋律进入的位置。
analysis.en: Compare the introduction with the ensemble section. Use recurring percussion patterns to track where the melody enters.

uncertainty.zh: 以沙湾何氏广东音乐的传播期标点，单曲改写和定稿的具体日期待考。
uncertainty.en: The date band represents the circulation of the He family’s music. The exact date of revision or completion is undetermined.

people.zh: 何柳堂（整理创作）；李复斌（指挥）
people.en: He Liutang, arranger and composer; Li Fubin, conductor

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展 · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble，第11、16页的广东音乐与丝竹合奏。
course.en: Course extension · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble, pp. 11 and 16, Guangdong music and silk-and-bamboo ensembles.

performer.zh: 李复斌指挥、珠海民族管弦乐团
performer.en: Zhuhai Chinese Orchestra, conducted by Li Fubin

credit.zh: 珠海民族管弦乐团演奏，李复斌指挥。央视于2020年播出。
credit.en: Zhuhai Chinese Orchestra, conducted by Li Fubin. CCTV broadcast in 2020.

prompt.zh: 听打击乐带出连续重拍的地方。它与前一段相比，是音量增强、节拍变密，还是两者都有？
prompt.en: Find the passage with recurring percussion accents. Compared with the preceding section, is it louder, denser, or both?

role.zh: 所选版本演出团体所在地
role.en: Home of the orchestra heard in the selected version

period.zh: 广东音乐传统曲目，所选珠海民族管弦乐团版本于2020年播出。
period.en: A Guangdong instrumental standard. CCTV broadcast this version by the Zhuhai Chinese Orchestra in 2020.

description.zh: 中国非遗网将《旱天雷》列为广东音乐代表曲。地图以乐团所在地珠海标点，试听采用民族管弦乐团编制。
description.en: China ICH lists the work as part of the Guangdong repertory. The map locates the performing orchestra in Zhuhai. The clip uses a full Chinese orchestra.

analysis.zh: 集中听旋律反复时的句尾。留意伴奏在哪些落点增强重音。
analysis.en: Focus on line endings when the melody recurs. Listen for where the accompaniment reinforces the accents.

uncertainty.zh: 2020年是所选版本播出时间。早期创作年份待核。
uncertainty.en: The selected version was broadcast in 2020. The early composition date remains unconfirmed.

performer.en: Zhuhai Chinese Orchestra, conducted by Li Fubin

credit.zh: 2020年珠海新年音乐会。
credit.en: Zhuhai New Year Concert, 2020.

prompt.zh: 在反复出现的旋律里挑一处收尾。旋律收束时，伴奏是同时停止，还是还在推动节拍？
prompt.en: Choose the ending of a recurring phrase. Does the accompaniment stop with the melody or keep the pulse moving?

title.en: Autumn Moon over a Calm Lake

role.zh: 作曲者吕文成出生地
role.en: Birthplace of composer Lü Wencheng

period.zh: 约20世纪20年代，吕文成创作。乐曲至迟于1930年已流传。
period.en: Composed by Lü Wencheng around the 1920s. The work was in circulation by 1930.

description.zh: 吕文成生于中山。《平湖秋月》的题材与杭州西湖有关，音乐使用岭南丝竹的行腔和润饰。地图以作曲者出生地标点。
description.en: Lü Wencheng was born in Zhongshan. The piece evokes Hangzhou’s West Lake and uses Lingnan instrumental phrasing and ornamentation. The map marks the composer’s birthplace.

analysis.zh: 先辨认一句较长的旋律，再听各声部是否在同一时刻加花。
analysis.en: Identify a longer melodic phrase, then listen for whether the players ornament it together.

uncertainty.zh: 创作年代采用香港康文署音乐会节目册的记载，确切年份待考。杭州与中山分别对应作品题材和作曲者出生地。
uncertainty.en: The approximate date follows the Hong Kong LCSD concert notes. The exact year remains undetermined. Hangzhou is the subject of the work and Zhongshan is the composer’s birthplace.

people.zh: 吕文成（作曲）；于川、高冠琳、孙莹、尚靖雅（所选版本）
people.en: Lü Wencheng, composer; Yu Chuan, Gao Guanlin, Sun Ying and Shang Jingya, performers

course.en: Course extension · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble, pp. 11 and 16, Guangdong music and silk-and-bamboo ensembles.

title.en: Autumn Moon over a Calm Lake

credit.zh: 央视《风华国乐》2021年播出。
credit.en: CCTV’s Fenghua Guoyue, broadcast in 2021.

prompt.zh: 听开头的长旋律。哪一个声音把音连起来，哪些声音用较短的音在旁边补充？
prompt.en: Listen to the opening phrase. Which instrument connects the notes, and which add shorter sounds around it?

title.en: Clear Waters of the Wanquan River

role.zh: 曲名所指万泉河的流经地
role.en: A city on the river named in the song

period.zh: 1964年，杜鸣心为舞剧《红色娘子军》改编写作。
period.en: Du Mingxin adapted the tune for the ballet The Red Detachment of Women in 1964.

description.zh: 杜鸣心采风后将《五指山歌》的旋律材料加工为舞剧插曲。这里以万泉河的流经地琼海标点，可与琼中收录的《五指山歌》对照。
description.en: After fieldwork, Du Mingxin reshaped melodic material from Song of Wuzhi Mountain for the ballet. The point is Qionghai on the Wanquan River. Compare the Wuzhi Mountain song mapped in Qiongzhong.

analysis.zh: 分别哼出两首歌的起句，比较跳进、拍子及句末时值。
analysis.en: Hum the opening phrases of both songs and compare leaps, pulse and note lengths at the ends.

uncertainty.zh: 1964年对应舞剧改编。试听版本来自2016年节目。
uncertainty.en: 1964 dates the adaptation. The selection comes from the 2016 TV programme.

description.en: Bayin seated singing is a Bouyei narrative tradition in Qianxinan. Players supply both accompaniment and singing. This performance is credited to the prefectural theatre and quyi association.

analysis.zh: 分辨胡琴拉弓与拨弦的音头，听唱词进入时这些声音如何让出空间。
analysis.en: Distinguish bowed tones from plucked attacks, and hear how the instruments make room when the words enter.

description.en: Dabenqu is a Bai-language narrative form, commonly accompanied by sanxian. CCTV identifies this version as a southern-style Dali piece. It illustrates how the language and accompaniment mark phrases.

analysis.zh: 先听字与字之间的停顿，再听三弦何处衔接人声。
analysis.en: Listen for pauses between syllables, then hear where the sanxian takes over from the voice.

description.en: New Liu Sanjie continues Caidiao’s alternation of song and dialogue. Nanning is home to the Guangxi Theatre. Compare this excerpt with the mountain-song adaptation mapped in Liuzhou.

role.zh: 石柱啰儿调流传地
role.en: Place of transmission for Shizhu Luo’er tunes

period.en: Regional folk material was adapted around 1942.

description.zh: 地方资料将此曲与石柱土家啰儿调相联系，也记载了后续歌词整理。地图按传统流传地定位，央视选段采用唐翰章和谭翼林的合唱。
description.en: Local accounts connect the work with Shizhu Tujia Luo’er tunes and document later work on the lyrics. Shizhu marks the area of transmission. The CCTV excerpt features Tang Hanzhang and Tan Yilin.

analysis.zh: 对照歌词和反复出现的衬字，听衬字怎样成为可辨认的节奏标记。
analysis.en: Compare words and recurring vocables. Hear how the vocables become a recurring rhythmic marker.

uncertainty.zh: 有关原始曲调及整理经过，地方资料有不同侧重点。石柱标示传统关联。

period.zh: 富川地方传统，所选唱词形成时间待考。
period.en: Fuchuan oral tradition. The date of these lyrics is undetermined.

description.zh: 瑶族蝴蝶歌流传于富川及邻近瑶族聚居区。曲种因唱词中的蝴蝶一类衬词得名。所选原声来自富川县文化馆的歌队。
description.en: Yao butterfly songs circulate in Fuchuan and neighbouring Yao communities. The form takes its name from repeated butterfly-related vocables. The selected performance is by the county cultural centre’s singers.

analysis.zh: 以一句的起音为参照，辨认两条声部何时分开，何时重新落在一起。
analysis.en: Use the opening note of a phrase to locate when the two parts diverge and come together again.

uncertainty.zh: 富川是该传统的传承地区之一。曲目来源与所选节目的播出日期分别标注。

description.zh: 香港中文大学中国音乐研究中心保存了杜焕的地水南音录音。所选片段由杜焕演唱、何臣拍和。地图和年代对应录音活动。
description.en: The Centre for Chinese Music at CUHK preserves Dou Wun’s naamyam recordings. In this excerpt, Ho San accompanies Dou Wun. The map and date refer to the recording event.

analysis.zh: 对照行腔里的缓急与伴奏的应答，尤其听唱声结束以后伴奏怎样延续。
analysis.en: Compare changes of pace in the vocal line with the accompaniment, especially where it continues after the singing stops.

description.zh: 这首器乐作品吸收了苗族飞歌的音乐特点。地图以黔东南为飞歌传承区域。所选为唐俊乔吹笛、中国爱乐乐团伴奏的版本。
description.en: The work draws on Miao flying-song material. The map marks Qiandongnan as an area of transmission. Tang Junqiao performs the selected flute version with the China Philharmonic Orchestra.

analysis.zh: 对照前面较自由的长音和节奏较明确的段落，听竹笛如何模拟山歌的呼唤。
analysis.en: Contrast the freely sustained notes with a more metrical passage and listen for the bamboo flute’s imitation of a vocal call.

description.en: Lhatse duixie combines dranyen playing, singing and steps. The programme incorporates it into a stage arrangement of Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. The point marks the tradition and the home of the Lhatse troupe.

analysis.zh: 结合扎念动作和踏步找出强拍。比较堆谐段进入前后的节奏织体。
analysis.en: Use the dranyen and steps to locate the strong beats. Compare the rhythmic texture before and after the duixie enters.

description.en: The Axi Moon Dance is a collective dance tradition of the Axi Yi in Mile. The selected report documents a local event. Compare the strings, footwork and changes of formation.

analysis.en: Find one recurring rhythmic unit, then use the footwork to locate its accents.

description.en: Face changing is a Sichuan opera stage technique for representing shifts in a character’s emotion. Compare it with Autumn River, also mapped in Chengdu, to study how music supports different kinds of theatrical action.

analysis.zh: 观察变脸一瞬与配乐重音的相对位置。比较几次动作，分辨音乐是否以相同方式提示变化。
analysis.en: Compare the moment of a face change with the musical accent. Check whether different changes receive the same cue.

credit.zh: 央视《宝贝亮相吧》2021年播出。
credit.en: CCTV Baobei Liangxiang Ba, broadcast in 2021.

prompt.zh: 选连续两次变脸。动作变化时，重音是跟着出现、提前出现，还是听不出共同位置？
prompt.en: Choose two successive face changes. Does the accent arrive with each movement, just before it, or at no consistent point?

role.zh: 广东音乐传承与传播地
role.en: Centre of Guangdong instrumental music

period.zh: 广东音乐传统曲目，所选版本于2022年播出。
period.en: Traditional Guangdong ensemble piece. The selected version was broadcast in 2022.

description.zh: 这首曲子的不同演绎都用乐器模拟鸟声。广州地方音乐资料记有刘天一以高胡高音区表现鸟鸣的做法，所选片段由余乐夫演奏。
description.en: Different renditions use instruments to imitate birds. Guangzhou’s documentation describes Liu Tianyi’s bird calls in the upper gaohu register. The selected excerpt features Yu Lefu.

analysis.zh: 把鸟鸣式的短音和持续的伴奏分开听，留意短音聚在一起时造成的空间感。
analysis.en: Listen separately to the short bird-like figures and the sustained accompaniment. Notice the effect when the short figures cluster.

uncertainty.zh: 早期曲谱及作者归属待进一步核对。
uncertainty.en: The early score and attribution remain to be confirmed.

people.zh: 刘天一（相关高胡演绎）；余乐夫（所选版本）
people.en: Liu Tianyi, associated gaohu interpretation; Yu Lefu, selected performance

genre.zh: 广东音乐，高胡与小乐队
genre.en: Guangdong instrumental music for gaohu and small ensemble

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展 · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble，第11、16页的广东音乐与丝竹合奏。
course.en: Course extension · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble, pp. 11 and 16, Guangdong music and silk-and-bamboo ensembles.

performer.zh: 余乐夫，吴迪、李志成、郎平、童绍民伴奏
performer.en: Yu Lefu with Wu Di, Li Zhicheng, Lang Ping and Tong Shaomin

credit.zh: 央视《风华国乐》2022年播出。
credit.en: CCTV Fenghua Guoyue, broadcast in 2022.

prompt.zh: 找一处像鸟叫的快速高音。它听起来像一个声音连续发出，还是像两个声音交替呼应？
prompt.en: Find a quick, high bird-like figure. Does it sound like one continuous call or two sounds answering each other?

title.en: Water and Song Welcome the Guests

role.zh: 所选地方曲种的传承地
role.en: Place of transmission for the regional song form

period.zh: 选用2026年央视播出的迎客歌曲。
period.en: The selected welcome song was broadcast by CCTV in 2026.

description.zh: 央视将《流水欢歌迎客来》标为富川瑶族蝴蝶歌。它可与同一富川站的文化馆歌队版本并听，比较曲种的地方语言和舞台处理。
description.en: CCTV identifies this welcome song as a Fuchuan Yao butterfly song. Compare it with the cultural-centre ensemble mapped at the same point and listen for local language and stage arrangement.

analysis.zh: 先跟随较明显的一条人声，再判断较高的声音在何处合进来。
analysis.en: Follow the most prominent voice first, then locate where a higher voice enters.

uncertainty.zh: 央视节目页可确认所选版本。曲目的创作、整理或首演时间待核。
uncertainty.en: The CCTV page identifies the selected version. The date of composition, arrangement or first performance is unconfirmed.

people.en: Shaoli Group, performers

course.zh: 课堂乐种拓展 · Chinese Folk Song，第10页的南方民歌与地方风格。
course.en: Course extension · Chinese Folk Song, p. 10, on southern folk-song style.

title.en: Water and Song Welcome the Guests

credit.zh: 央视《民歌中国》2026年播出。
credit.en: CCTV Folk Songs of China, broadcast in 2026.

prompt.zh: 在第一个完整句子里，第二条声部从句首就出现，还是等主唱开口之后才加入？
prompt.en: In the first complete line, does the second voice start immediately or join after the lead?

name.zh: 内蒙古锡林郭勒（锡林浩特）

role.zh: 锡林郭勒长调流传区的代表点
role.en: City marker for the Xilingol long-song tradition

period.zh: 2019年3月29日，央视网发布《回声嘹亮》的《小黄马》片段。
period.en: CCTV published this performance of Little Yellow Horse on 29 March 2019.

description.zh: 在锡林郭勒草原传唱的《小黄马》，是蒙古族长调的代表曲目。王宏伟曾在电台访谈中回忆，他向蒙古族歌手请教多年，才逐渐掌握长音里细小的颤动。
description.en: Little Yellow Horse is a Mongolian long song sung on the Xilingol grasslands. In a radio interview, Wang Hongwei recalled asking Mongolian singers for advice for years before he learnt to shape the small turns within a sustained note.

analysis.zh: 先跟着一个长音轻轻哼唱，留意歌手在哪些地方改变音高。等他换气时，再听马头琴把上一句接到了哪里。
analysis.en: Hum along with one sustained vowel and listen for each change of pitch. When the singer takes a breath, follow the horsehead fiddle to hear where it takes the phrase.

uncertainty.zh: 锡林浩特代表草原流传区。曲调形成年代和本场录制的日期、地点待核。
uncertainty.en: Xilinhot represents the wider grassland tradition. The date of the tune and the date and venue of this recording remain unverified.

people.zh: 王宏伟（演唱）、蒙根（马头琴）
people.en: Wang Hongwei (voice) and Menggen (morin khuur)

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 对照《中国民歌》第18页，听旋律、节奏与歌词的关系。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Folk Song, p. 18, on melody, rhythm and language.

title.en: Little Yellow Horse · voice and morin khuur

performer.zh: 王宏伟（演唱）、蒙根（马头琴）

credit.zh: 央视《回声嘹亮》，王宏伟演唱，蒙根演奏马头琴。央视网于2019年3月29日发布片段。
credit.en: Wang Hongwei sings with Menggen on morin khuur. CCTV published the clip from Echoes Resound on 29 March 2019.

prompt.zh: 选一个被拉长的音节。歌手还在唱同一个字时，你能听见旋律转了几次弯？
prompt.en: Pick a sustained syllable. How many turns in the melody can you hear before the singer moves on to the next syllable?

excerpt.zh: 原片 00:28–02:42，略过开头的节目访谈，保留马头琴引子。
excerpt.en: 00:28–02:42 of the CCTV clip, starting with the fiddle introduction after the interview.

role.zh: 以县城标示饶河四排的嫁令阔传承区域
role.en: County-seat marker for the tradition in Sipai

period.zh: 1959年，《歌曲》第12期刊载《狩猎的哥哥回来了》。
period.en: The song appeared in issue 12 of Gequ (Songs) in 1959.

description.zh: 《等阿哥》和《狩猎的哥哥回来了》用同一支嫁令阔曲调唱不同的词。饶河县四排是传唱嫁令阔的地方之一。这里播放黑龙江歌手李萃琳唱的《狩猎的哥哥回来了》。
description.en: Hezhe singers set different words to the same Jialingkuo melody in Waiting for My Love and The Hunter Has Returned. Sipai in Raohe is one of the places where Jialingkuo is sung. This recording features Li Cuilin singing the latter song.

analysis.zh: 先听每一句最后落在哪个音上，再比较换词后句尾走向是否相似。
analysis.en: Listen for the pitch at the end of each line. Compare how the line endings move when the words change.

uncertainty.zh: 时间轴据刊载年份。曲调形成年代、央视录制日期与地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks publication. The tune’s origin date and the date and place of recording remain unverified.

people.en: Li Cuilin

course.zh: 课外选曲 ·《中国民歌》第18页，比较同一条旋律怎样配上不同的词。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Folk Song, p. 18, on the relationship between melody and words.

credit.zh: 李萃琳演唱，央视《民歌中国》片段于2026年1月30日公开。
credit.en: Li Cuilin, voice. CCTV published the Folk Songs of China clip on 30 January 2026.

prompt.zh: 听完第一句，试着哼出它的收尾。下一句换了词，你能在哪儿接着哼？
prompt.en: Hum the end of the first line. Where can you join in when the next line brings new words?

role.zh: 传承人董孝芳的家乡及早年入团地
role.en: Home of Dong Xiaofang and his first professional troupe

period.zh: 1955年，董孝芳进入梨树县地方戏剧团。
period.en: Dong Xiaofang joined the Lishu County Local Theatre Troupe in 1955.

description.zh: 梨树人董孝芳和搭档郑淑云把《杨八姐游春》唱成一场两人的戏。听一人唱到句尾时，另一个人怎样接住下一句，再看手上的扇子怎样提示这次交接。
description.en: Dong Xiaofang, a native of Lishu, and Zheng Shuyun tell the story of Eighth Sister Yang in a duet. Listen for the point where one takes over the other’s line, then watch how a fan signals the handover.

analysis.zh: 留意两人一递一接的句尾，再看扇子的开合是否与换人同时。
analysis.en: Follow the end of each performer’s line and watch whether the fan moves at the moment the other voice enters.

uncertainty.zh: 时间轴标记演员进入当地剧团的年份。节目字幕标明资料年份为1990年。剧目首演时间、档案画面的实际录制日期和地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks Dong’s entry into the Lishu troupe. The premiere and the recording date and venue of the archive footage remain unverified.

people.en: Dong Xiaofang and Zheng Shuyun

course.zh: 课外选曲 ·《中国说唱音乐》第5页，从两个人的声音辨别说、唱和角色转换。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 5, on spoken and sung narration.

credit.zh: 表演：董孝芳、郑淑云。画面注明“1990年资料”，央视戏曲频道《典藏》于2024年11月12日公开。
credit.en: Dong Xiaofang and Zheng Shuyun, in footage labelled 1990. CCTV’s Xiqu Channel published the Archives programme on 12 November 2024.

prompt.zh: 先闭眼听一句交接，再看两人的手势。你最先从哪个声音听出换了人？
prompt.en: Listen with your eyes closed, then watch the gesture. Which sound first tells you that the other performer has taken over?

excerpt.zh: 整期节目 01:35–04:10，取第一曲中的155秒。
excerpt.en: 01:35–04:10 of the full programme, a 155-second excerpt from the first number.

title.zh: 东北大鼓 · 锦州与复州对听
title.en: Northeastern drum storytelling · Jinzhou and Fuzhou

aliases: A Song of the Twenty-Four Solar Terms

role.zh: 西城派传承中心及《奶奶的梦里事》的演出城市
role.en: Centre of the Xicheng school and a documented performance city for Grandmother’s Dream

period.zh: 2015年，锦州市首届群众文化节演出西城派《奶奶的梦里事》。
period.en: Grandmother’s Dream was performed at Jinzhou’s first public arts festival in 2015.

description.zh: 锦州是东北大鼓西城派的传承中心。中国非遗网收录了锦州市群众艺术馆的《奶奶的梦里事》。站内可对听瓦房店一带的另一种唱法：冷依阳表演复州东北大鼓《咏二十四节气》。
description.en: Jinzhou is a centre of the Xicheng school of Northeastern drum storytelling. The national heritage archive features the Jinzhou Mass Art Centre’s Grandmother’s Dream. To hear another Liaoning tradition, play Leng Yiyang’s A Song of the Twenty-Four Solar Terms, from the Fuzhou tradition of Wafangdian.

analysis.zh: 在锦州版和复州版各找一处唱句的停顿，听停顿处留下的是鼓点、弦声还是人声。
analysis.en: Choose a pause in each performance. Which sound fills it: a drumbeat, strings or a voice?

instruments.en: Voice, drum, clappers and string accompaniment

uncertainty.zh: 时间轴据锦州2015年演出。两份视频的原始录制日期和地点、逐件乐器与演奏者待核。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks the 2015 Jinzhou performance. The recording dates, venues, detailed instrumentation and instrumentalists for both videos remain unverified.

people.zh: 锦州版由锦州市群众艺术馆演出，列名李丽明、黄建立等。站内复州版由冷依阳表演。
people.en: The Jinzhou Mass Art Centre credits Li Liming, Huang Jianli and others for the Jinzhou performance. Leng Yiyang performs the Fuzhou selection in the player.

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 与《中国说唱音乐》第10页的京韵大鼓对听，听辨鼓、弦怎样衬托唱句。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Compare how drum and strings support the voice here and in jingyun dagu on p. 10 of Chinese Narrative Singing.

title.zh: 复州东北大鼓《咏二十四节气》
title.en: A Song of the Twenty-Four Solar Terms (Fuzhou drum storytelling)

credit.zh: 冷依阳表演复州东北大鼓《咏二十四节气》。央视少儿频道《大手牵小手》于2018年9月1日公开。
credit.en: Leng Yiyang performs the Fuzhou-style A Song of the Twenty-Four Solar Terms. CCTV’s Children’s Channel published the clip on 1 September 2018.

prompt.zh: 听冷依阳唱完一句节气名，鼓点先落在最后一个字上，还是落在字后的空隙里？
prompt.en: As Leng Yiyang names a solar term, does the drumbeat land on the last syllable or in the pause after it?

role.zh: 天津时调流行的城市
role.en: City where the shidiao tradition flourished

period.zh: 央视《典藏》画面将王毓宝的演出标为20世纪90年代资料。节目页发布于2021年3月27日。
period.en: CCTV dates Wang Yubao’s archival performance to the 1990s. The programme page was published on 27 March 2021.

description.zh: 清末民初，天津时调在天津城区流行，艺人将本地小调和外来的曲调唱成天津的声口。王毓宝自幼随父学唱，1953年进入天津广播曲艺团，专唱时调。
description.en: Around the turn of the twentieth century, Tianjin singers adapted local and visiting tunes to the sound of the city’s speech. Wang Yubao learnt from her father and went on to specialise in shidiao at the Tianjin Broadcasting Quyi Troupe in 1953.

analysis.zh: 描写蜻蜓风筝时，先跟着王毓宝的吐字找节奏。等她转身叫“大姐”，注意这一句里哪个字拖得最久。
analysis.en: Follow Wang’s syllables as she describes a dragonfly kite. When she turns to call out to her elder sister, listen for the syllable she holds longest.

uncertainty.zh: 这首曲子的成曲年代、这次录像的确切年份与场地待核。
uncertainty.en: The date of the song and the exact year and venue of this recording remain unverified.

people.zh: 王毓宝（演唱），韩利祥、张玉恒、王桂玲、于宝树、刘小凯（伴奏）
people.en: Wang Yubao (voice), with Han Lixiang, Zhang Yuheng, Wang Guiling, Yu Baoshu and Liu Xiaokai (accompaniment)

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 对照《中国说唱音乐》第9页的天津快板，听字音如何在唱腔里拉长。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Compare the timing of sung syllables with the clappers in Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 9.

performer.zh: 王毓宝（演唱），韩利祥、张玉恒、王桂玲、于宝树、刘小凯（伴奏）
performer.en: Wang Yubao (voice), with Han Lixiang, Zhang Yuheng, Wang Guiling, Yu Baoshu and Liu Xiaokai (accompaniment)

credit.zh: 王毓宝演唱，韩利祥、张玉恒、王桂玲、于宝树、刘小凯伴奏。央视戏曲频道《典藏》于2021年3月27日发布这段20世纪90年代的演出资料。
credit.en: Wang Yubao sings with Han Lixiang, Zhang Yuheng, Wang Guiling, Yu Baoshu and Liu Xiaokai. CCTV-11 published this archival performance from the 1990s on 27 March 2021.

prompt.zh: 先听蜻蜓风筝上下飞腾的一句。唱到“叫声大姐呀”时，哪个字被拉长了？
prompt.en: First listen to the line about the dragonfly kite swooping up and down. When Wang calls to her elder sister, which syllable does she stretch?

excerpt.zh: 原片 00:30–01:05，从描写蜻蜓风筝听到呼唤“大姐”。
excerpt.en: 00:30–01:05 of the original, from the description of the dragonfly kite to the call to an elder sister.

role.zh: 乐亭大鼓发源县的县城
role.en: County seat where the Laoting drum-song tradition originated

period.zh: 何建春回忆，1979年他参加李田的大鼓培训班，学唱《双锁山》等书段。本站播放的是央视2025年2月12日发布的元宵演出。
period.en: He Jianchun recalls learning this story at Li Tian’s drum-song class in 1979. CCTV published the Lantern Festival performance heard here on 12 February 2025.

description.zh: 乐亭大鼓在冀东流传，艺人用鼓和板掌握叙事的步子。何建春最初跟着收音机模仿靳文然，后来向李田学会《双锁山》。在这版元宵演出里，几位演员各持一副板，把人物的装束一句句唱出来。
description.en: In eastern Hebei, Laoting storytellers set the pace with a drum and clappers. He Jianchun first imitated Jin Wenran on the radio and later learnt Double Lock Mountain from Li Tian. In this Lantern Festival performance, several performers hold their own clappers and sing a description of a character’s dress.

analysis.zh: 选一行唱词，用手跟着板声轻轻打拍。等另一位演员接唱时，试试看还能不能把同一个拍子打下去。
analysis.en: Tap along with the clappers through one line. When another singer takes over, see whether you can keep the same pulse.

uncertainty.zh: 书段的编创年代、其他表演者的完整署名及演出的确切录制日期待核。
uncertainty.en: The date of the story’s composition, the complete cast and the exact recording date remain unverified.

people.en: He Jianchun, Zhao Yuqi and fellow performers

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 对照《中国说唱音乐》第10页的京韵大鼓，听冀东鼓书怎样用板声衬托唱词。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Compare the Beijing drum song in Chinese Narrative Singing, p. 10, with the way eastern Hebei performers use clappers under the words.

title.zh: 乐亭大鼓《双锁山》选段 · 何建春、赵予淇等
title.en: Double Lock Mountain · He Jianchun, Zhao Yuqi and fellow performers

performer.en: He Jianchun, Zhao Yuqi and fellow performers

credit.zh: 央视戏曲频道《戏聚河头 福满新春 元宵特辑》于2025年2月12日发布。何建春、赵予淇等表演乐亭大鼓《双锁山》选段。
credit.en: CCTV-11 published this Lantern Festival performance on 12 February 2025. He Jianchun, Zhao Yuqi and fellow performers sing an excerpt from Double Lock Mountain.

prompt.zh: 先随一行唱词打拍。换人接唱时，手里的板是跟着每个字落下，还是在字与字之间也有响声？
prompt.en: Tap along with one line. When the voice changes, is there a clapper stroke for every syllable, or can you hear strokes between the words too?

excerpt.zh: 原片 00:07–00:55，听人物装束的唱词和换人接唱，片末可对照手中板的特写。
excerpt.en: 00:07–00:55 of the original. Listen to the singers describing the character’s dress and passing the verse between them. The camera closes in on the clappers near the end.

title.en: Red Peach Blossoms, White Apricot Blossoms

name.zh: 山西晋中左权县（辽阳镇）

role.zh: 开花调流传县的县城
role.en: County seat marking the home of Zuoquan flowering tunes

period.zh: 1953年，刘改鱼向左权民间艺人程计年搜集到《桃花红杏花白》。央视于2025年1月13日发布这段由她本人演唱的节目。
period.en: In 1953, Liu Gaiyu collected this song from Cheng Jinian, a local singer in Zuoquan. CCTV published Liu’s performance on 13 January 2025.

description.zh: 左权的歌手常借花起兴，先唱眼前的景物，再说心里的话。刘改鱼向当地艺人程计年学得这首山歌。在这次演唱中，她从桃花的红、杏花的白唱到翻山寻人。
description.en: Zuoquan singers often begin with blossoms before turning to their feelings. Liu Gaiyu learnt this mountain song from local singer Cheng Jinian. Here she sings first of red peach blossoms and white apricot blossoms, then of crossing the hills to find someone.

analysis.zh: 开头先哼一遍“桃花”一句的收尾，再接唱“杏花”一句，听第二句的落音有没有回到同样的位置。
analysis.en: Hum the end of the first line about peach blossoms. Sing along when the apricot blossoms appear and listen for where the second line lands.

uncertainty.zh: 传统曲调的创作年代、电视演出的具体录制日期和地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The date of composition and the date and venue of the television recording remain unverified.

people.en: Liu Gaiyu (voice)

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 与《中国民歌》第8页的河北花调对听，用第18页的旋律、节奏与歌词分析两句花名。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Compare the Hebei flower songs on p. 8 of Chinese Folk Song, using the approach to melody, rhythm and lyrics on p. 18.

title.zh: 《桃花红杏花白》· 刘改鱼演唱
title.en: Red Peach Blossoms, White Apricot Blossoms · Liu Gaiyu

credit.zh: 央视音乐频道《民歌中国》，刘改鱼演唱山西左权开花调《桃花红杏花白》。节目页于2025年1月13日发布。
credit.en: Liu Gaiyu sings this Zuoquan flowering tune on CCTV-15’s Folk Songs of China. CCTV published the segment on 13 January 2025.

prompt.zh: 留意“红”和“白”附近的旋律。两句唱到末尾时，是落在同样的高度，还是一高一低？
prompt.en: Listen to the words for red and white. Do the phrases end at the same pitch or does one land higher?

excerpt.zh: 原片 00:04–00:50，从桃花、杏花的起句听到第二段唱词，止于节目转入访谈前。
excerpt.en: 00:04–00:50 of the original, from the opening blossom lines through the next verse, before the cut to an interview.

title.en: Jiangzhou drums · The Prince of Qin Musters His Troops

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 与《中国器乐合奏》第14页的十番锣鼓对听，比较几种击声怎样衔接。
course.en: Supplementary listening for p. 14 of Chinese Instrumental Ensemble. Compare how players fit their strokes together here and in shifan luogu.

role.zh: 绛州鼓乐传承地，以新绛县城为代表点
role.en: County seat marking the local Jiangzhou drumming tradition

period.zh: 1987年，为新绛县农民锣鼓队创作此曲。
period.en: Composed in 1987 for the farmers’ percussion ensemble of Xinjiang County.

description.zh: 新绛县的鼓手把鼓面、鼓边都当作可以发声的地方。《秦王点兵》写的是秦王点将的场面，1987 年为当地农民锣鼓队创作。这里播放山西绛州鼓乐艺术团的舞台版本。
description.en: Drummers in Xinjiang County play both the drumhead and the rim. This piece, written in 1987 for the local farmers’ percussion ensemble, imagines the Prince of Qin mustering his troops. The recording features the Shanxi Jiangzhou Drum Ensemble.

analysis.zh: 看鼓槌从一面鼓换到另一面鼓。闭上眼再听一次，试着从短促的敲击声和带余响的鼓声里辨出换手的位置。
analysis.en: Watch the sticks move from drum to drum. Then close your eyes and try to place the changes by listening for clipped taps and resonant strokes.

instruments.zh: 大小鼓及金属打击乐器
instruments.en: Drums of different sizes and metal percussion

people.en: Shanxi Jiangzhou Drum Ensemble

uncertainty.zh: 时间轴采用作品创作年。央视署名到团体，本次演出的录制日期、场馆和个人演奏名单待核。
uncertainty.en: The timeline marks the year of composition. CCTV credits the ensemble. The recording date, venue and individual players remain unverified.

title.en: Jiangzhou drums · The Prince of Qin Musters His Troops

credit.zh: 山西绛州鼓乐艺术团演奏，央视音乐频道《风华国乐》2025年4月22日发布。
credit.en: Performed by the Shanxi Jiangzhou Drum Ensemble. Published by CCTV Music on 22 April 2025.

prompt.zh: 先只听声音，再看鼓手落槌。哪种声音又脆又短，哪种声音落下后还在振动？
prompt.en: Listen once, then watch where the sticks land. Which sound cuts off sharply, and which keeps ringing?

excerpt.zh: 原片 00:26–01:12，可见前排鼓手击奏和鼓面的近景。
excerpt.en: 00:26–01:12 in the CCTV performance, including a close-up of the front-row drums.

title.en: Three Drops of Blood · The Pact (Qinqiang opera)

role.zh: 城市代表点。范紫东的剧本见西安易俗社档案，央视这一版也由易俗社演出。
role.en: City-level marker for the Yisushe troupe, whose archives hold Fan Zidong’s play and whose production is featured here.

period.zh: 民国。西安曲江新区记首演于1918年，央视戏曲影像馆记1919年。
period.en: Republican era. Xi’an Qujiang New District dates the premiere to 1918, and the CCTV Xiqu archive gives 1919.

description.zh: 李遇春与周天佑途中相逢，各自讲起家事。在写到韩城、杏花村的两句里，李遇春把地名唱得格外分明。
description.en: Li Yuchun and Zhou Tianyou meet on the road and exchange family histories. In Li’s first two lines, the names of Hancheng and Xinghua Village stand out as he sings them.

analysis.zh: 先跟李遇春报家门时的字音，再听苦音二六怎样在一句的末尾给尾字留出空间。
analysis.en: Follow the syllables as Li identifies his hometown, then listen for the room left at each line ending by the kuyin erliu tune pattern.

instruments.zh: 秦腔唱腔及弦乐、打击乐伴奏
instruments.en: Qinqiang voice with strings and percussion

people.zh: 西安易俗社 · 陈超武饰李遇春，李东峰饰周天佑
people.en: Xi’an Yisushe · Chen Chaowu as Li Yuchun and Li Dongfeng as Zhou Tianyou

course.zh: 课堂剧种 · 《戏曲》（xiqu.pptx）第18页将秦腔列入梆子腔。《导论》第17页介绍戏曲表演，本站选《结盟》一折作补充试听。
course.en: Course genre · Slide 18 of the xiqu deck places Qinqiang in the bangzi family. Introduction, slide 17, introduces opera performance. The Pact is supplementary listening.

uncertainty.zh: 首演的确切年份待核，地图以1918–1919年容纳两种记载。试听为央视2013年公开的演出，实际录制日期和场地待核。
uncertainty.en: The premiere year remains uncertain. The map spans the two published dates, 1918–1919. CCTV released the featured performance in 2013. Its recording date and venue remain unverified.

title.en: The Pact · My Family Comes from Hancheng in Shaanxi

performer.zh: 西安易俗社 · 陈超武饰李遇春，李东峰饰周天佑
performer.en: Xi’an Yisushe · Chen Chaowu as Li Yuchun and Li Dongfeng as Zhou Tianyou

credit.zh: 央视《九州大戏台》2013年10月30日发布的单折。西安易俗社演出，陈超武饰李遇春，李东峰饰周天佑。
credit.en: CCTV released this scene from the Xi’an Yisushe production on 30 October 2013, with Chen Chaowu as Li Yuchun and Li Dongfeng as Zhou Tianyou.

prompt.zh: 唱到“韩城县”和“有家园”时，哪一个字拖得长？伴奏在哪个字后接上来？
prompt.en: At the ends of the lines naming Hancheng and the family home, which syllable lasts longest? Where does the accompaniment answer?

excerpt.zh: 央视单折全长07:52，取02:08–03:22（128–202秒），含李遇春自报家门的唱段。
excerpt.en: 02:08–03:22 of the 07:52 scene, including Li’s account of his family origins.

title.en: Once a Year to Lianhua Mountain

role.zh: 县城附城镇，代表县西南的莲花山花儿会地区
role.en: Fucheng county seat, marking the festival region southwest of town

period.zh: 2013年，文香莲、杨梅兰、何兰兰在临夏花儿艺术节演唱此曲。
period.en: In 2013 Wen Xianglian, Yang Meilan and He Lanlan performed the song at a hua’er festival in Linxia.

description.zh: 每年上山赶会的盼头，被写进了莲花山花儿的四句短词。康乐传承人文香莲开口唱出“一年一趟莲花山”，纪录片随后把想赶会的人愿意放下哪些事讲给听众。
description.en: Four short lines tell how much people look forward to the annual trip up Lianhua Mountain. Kangle singer Wen Xianglian sings the opening line. The documentary then gives the words about what someone would set aside to go.

analysis.zh: 留意开头“一年一趟莲花山”的“山”。随后听解说接出余句，比较“山、看、钱、天”四个句尾在当地唱词中的呼应。
analysis.en: Listen to shan (mountain) at the end of the sung opening. As the commentary gives the rest of the verse, compare the sounds of the four line endings: shan, kan, qian and tian.

instruments.zh: 女声示范，含纪录片解说

uncertainty.zh: 节目未为这一段单列曲令名称，是否即《莲花山令》待核。外景的拍摄日期与具体地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The programme gives no separate tune name for this passage. Its identification as Lianhuashan ling and the filming date and exact location remain unverified.

people.en: Wen Xianglian

genre.zh: 洮岷花儿 · 莲花山单套花儿
genre.en: Taomin hua’er · Lianhua Mountain single-stanza song

course.zh: 课外选曲 ·《中国民歌》第18页，比较同一句词在唱与念时的字长和呼吸。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Folk Song, p. 18, comparing the rhythm of sung and spoken words.

title.en: Once a Year to Lianhua Mountain

credit.zh: 文香莲。央视《中国影像方志》于2020年5月10日发布。
credit.en: Wen Xianglian. CCTV published this Local Chronicles of China clip on 10 May 2020.

prompt.zh: 开头七个字里，最后的“山”比前面哪个字拖得久？跟着念一次，你会在哪里换气？
prompt.en: Which earlier syllable is shorter than the final shan in the seven-syllable opening line? Speak the line yourself. Where do you need a breath?

excerpt.zh: 《康乐篇·非遗记》03:01–03:18，文香莲开腔及随后解说，共17秒。
excerpt.en: 03:01–03:18 of the Kangle documentary, a 17-second passage with Wen’s sung opening and the ensuing narration.

role.zh: 县治桥头镇，标示老爷山花儿会传承地区
role.en: County seat at Qiaotou, marking the home of the Laoye Mountain festival

period.zh: 2025年，大通第十六届老爷山花儿会演唱了此曲。
period.en: The song was performed at Datong’s 16th Laoye Mountain Hua’er Festival in 2025.

description.zh: 这支河湟花儿在大通老爷山花儿会上唱过。吴玉兰和索南孙斌的电视版本里，唱到鸽子时插入一串滚动的衬词，隔开了描写鸽子的前后两半句。
description.en: This Hehuang song has been heard at Datong’s Laoye Mountain festival. In Wu Yulan and Suonan Sunbin’s TV duet, a rolling string of sung syllables slips between the two halves of a line about doves.

analysis.zh: 在00:25–00:40间，先听清“雪白的鸽子”，再等唱词接回“飞到天里来”。中间反复的衬词也是曲令得名的线索。
analysis.en: At 00:25–00:40, follow the line from the white doves to their flight. Between these images comes the string of vocables that gives the tune its name.

instruments.en: Female and male voices with stage accompaniment

uncertainty.zh: 央视演出的录制日期、地点和伴奏人员待核。
uncertainty.en: The recording date, venue and accompanists for the CCTV duet remain unverified.

people.en: Wu Yulan and Suonan Sunbin

genre.zh: 河湟花儿 · 仓啷啷令

course.zh: 课外选曲 ·《中国民歌》第18页，听语言与节奏怎样配合。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Folk Song, p. 18, on language and rhythm.

credit.zh: 吴玉兰、索南孙斌。央视《中国民歌大会》于2016年10月2日发布。
credit.en: Wu Yulan and Suonan Sunbin. CCTV published this Chinese Folk Song Festival clip on 2 October 2016.

prompt.zh: 听到“鸽子”后，用手指在桌面敲出衬词的节奏。哪一句歌词让你的手停下来？
prompt.en: After the word for doves, tap the rhythm of the repeated syllables. Which sung words end that pattern?

role.zh: 固原市区，代表六盘山歌区
role.en: City marker for the Liupan Mountain song region

period.zh: 20世纪30年代，王洛宾在六盘山一带听录这支山花儿，确年有异说。
period.en: Wang Luobin documented the song in the Liupan Mountains in the 1930s. Accounts differ on the year.

description.zh: 固原一带传唱的这首山花儿写离别。银川歌手马慧茹反复唱到人走远了。第一次随后的词是眼泪，下一次却换成了心事。
description.en: This song of parting is heard around Guyuan. In the TV solo, Yinchuan singer Ma Huiru repeatedly follows someone walking away. One verse turns to tears, the next to a weight on the heart.

analysis.zh: 比较00:20–00:45和00:58–01:23。两处都从越走越远唱起，后面的词换了。听她在哪里停顿，又把哪个字拖到句尾。
analysis.en: Compare 00:20–00:45 with 00:58–01:23. Both passages begin with someone walking farther away, then the words diverge. Listen for the pauses and for the syllables the singer holds at each ending.

instruments.en: Solo female voice with stage accompaniment

uncertainty.zh: 资料所记采录年份有1936年和1938年两说，确年待核。央视录制日期、地点及伴奏人员待核。
uncertainty.en: Sources give 1936 and 1938 for the collecting encounter. Its exact year and the date, venue and accompanists of the CCTV recording remain unverified.

people.en: Ma Huiru

genre.en: Hui mountain hua’er of the Liupan Mountains

course.zh: 课外选曲 ·《中国民歌》第18页，听同一处旋律怎样容纳不同的词。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Folk Song, p. 18, on melody and language.

credit.zh: 马慧茹。央视《民歌中国》于2025年6月28日发布。
credit.en: Ma Huiru. CCTV published this Folk Songs of China clip on 28 June 2025.

prompt.zh: 第二次唱到人走远时，上一段的“眼泪”换成了什么？新的词还落在你记得的那个长音上吗？
prompt.en: When the traveller walks away a second time, what takes the place of tears? Do the new words reach the long note where you remember it?

title.zh: 十二木卡姆 · 纳瓦木卡姆选段
title.en: The Twelve Muqam · An excerpt from Nawa Muqam

role.zh: 莎车县城代表县内荒地镇的传承区域。2023年演出见于荒地镇阔纳巴扎村。
role.en: The county seat marks the tradition practised in Huangdi Township. Qonabazar village in Huangdi hosted the documented 2023 performance.

period.zh: 2023年12月12日，荒地镇艺人在阔纳巴扎村演奏《纳瓦木卡姆序曲》。
period.en: On 12 December 2023, musicians from Huangdi played the prelude to Nawa Muqam in Qonabazar village.

description.zh: 《纳瓦》是十二木卡姆中的一套。莎车荒地镇有村中艺人演奏其序曲的记录。听天山雪莲木卡姆乐团的舞台选段时，可以先跟着女声唱一行，再听身旁的拨弦和手鼓。
description.en: Nawa is one of the Twelve Muqam. Musicians in Huangdi, Shache, have performed its prelude in the village. In this stage excerpt by the Tianshan Snow Lotus Muqam Ensemble, follow a line of the woman’s singing, then pick out the plucked strings and frame drums alongside her.

analysis.zh: 看主唱手中的弓，再找舞台两侧的手鼓。一个唱音延长时，数一数鼓手的击点，听拨弦声落在两次鼓点之间的什么位置。
analysis.en: Watch the bow in the singer’s hand, then find the frame drums at the sides of the stage. Count their strokes through a sustained sung note and listen for where the plucks fall between beats.

instruments.zh: 人声、拉弦与弹拨乐器、手鼓
instruments.en: Voice, bowed and plucked strings, and frame drums

people.en: Tianshan Snow Lotus Muqam Ensemble

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 《中国器乐合奏》第4页讨论不同乐器怎样协作，本段可比较弓弦、拨弦与手鼓如何伴唱。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble, slide 4, discusses how instrumental parts interact. Compare how bowed strings, plucked strings and frame drums support the voice.

uncertainty.zh: 地图标记2023年莎车艺人演奏序曲的事件。站内另播央视2016年发布的同套曲舞台选段。其乐章名、逐人名单及录制地点待核。
uncertainty.en: The map dates the documented 2023 village performance of the prelude. The audio comes from CCTV’s 2016 release of a stage excerpt from the same suite. Its movement, individual credits and recording venue remain unverified.

title.zh: 《纳瓦木卡姆选段》· 天山雪莲木卡姆乐团
title.en: Nawa Muqam excerpt · Tianshan Snow Lotus Muqam Ensemble

credit.zh: 央视《民歌中国》2016年12月2日发布的维吾尔族歌曲专场，第15项。节目单与画面均署天山雪莲木卡姆乐团。
credit.en: Item 15 of CCTV’s Uyghur music concert released on 2 December 2016. Both the programme listing and the on-screen title credit the Tianshan Snow Lotus Muqam Ensemble.

prompt.zh: 主唱把一个字拉长时，手鼓敲了几下？拨弦的短音又落在哪里？
prompt.en: How many drum strokes fit under one sustained syllable? Where do the short plucked notes fall?

excerpt.en: 61:21–64:10 of the 69:20 programme, beginning with the on-screen title of item 15.

role.zh: 伊宁市作为伊犁哈萨克自治州的区域代表点。该州申报了卡拉角勒哈传统舞蹈。
role.en: The city of Yining represents Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, which nominated Kara Jorga for the heritage register.

period.zh: 2011年3月29日，央视公开这版《哈拉角勒哈》。同年，伊犁州申报的同名舞蹈列入国家级非遗名录。
period.en: CCTV published this performance on 29 March 2011. The Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture’s dance of the same name entered the national heritage list that year.

description.zh: 在伊犁，黑走马既是舞名，也是冬布拉为它伴奏时所弹的曲名。央视节目用乐队编配来演这支舞曲。留意坐在前排的拨弦乐手，再看舞步和弓弦声部怎样与他们合拍。
description.en: In Ili, Kara Jorga names both the dance and the tune played on dombra to accompany it. CCTV presents an ensemble arrangement. Watch the plucked-string players and follow how the dancers and bowed strings keep time with them.

analysis.zh: 先找拨弦的短音，再留意相邻的弓弦能把一个音拉多长。同一拍上，两种音的收尾有何不同？
analysis.en: Find the short plucked notes, then listen to the longer notes of the bowed strings. How do the two sounds decay when they start on the same beat?

instruments.zh: 冬布拉等弹拨乐器、弓弦及吹奏乐器
instruments.en: Dombra and other plucked strings, bowed strings and winds

people.zh: 吐尔逊江、顾新生、库尔曼江、阿娜尔等
people.en: Tuerxunjiang, Gu Xinsheng, Kuermanjiang, Anaer and others

course.zh: 课外选曲 · 《中国器乐合奏》第4页介绍不同乐器的配合，可比较这段乐队版如何用拨奏、拉奏和吹奏组织舞曲节拍。
course.en: Supplementary repertoire · Chinese Instrumental Ensemble, slide 4, introduces the interaction of instrumental parts. Compare plucked, bowed and wind sounds in this dance arrangement.

uncertainty.zh: 2011年对应该版节目公开及舞蹈入录。舞曲成曲年、此录像的录制地点和人员与乐器的逐一对应待核。
uncertainty.en: The year 2011 dates the dance’s listing. CCTV released the programme that same year. The tune’s composition date, the recording venue and the individual players’ instrument assignments remain unverified.

title.zh: 《哈拉角勒哈》· 哈萨克族民间舞曲器乐合奏
title.en: Kara Jorga · Kazakh dance tune in an instrumental arrangement

performer.zh: 吐尔逊江、顾新生、库尔曼江、阿娜尔等
performer.en: Tuerxunjiang, Gu Xinsheng, Kuermanjiang, Anaer and others

credit.zh: 央视《风华国乐·炫丽·新疆》2011年3月29日发布。琴弦和吹奏乐器同台，节目列吐尔逊江、顾新生、库尔曼江、阿娜尔等为表演者。
credit.en: CCTV released this Xinjiang episode of Splendour of Chinese Music on 29 March 2011. Strings and winds perform together. The programme credits Tuerxunjiang, Gu Xinsheng, Kuermanjiang, Anaer and others.

prompt.zh: 先随反复的拨弦重音拍手。弓弦把旋律拉长时，你还能拍在原来的位置吗？
prompt.en: Clap with the recurring plucked accents. When the bowed strings stretch out the melody, can you keep your clap in the same place?

excerpt.en: 16:23–17:40 of the 27:07 programme, within item 6, including its title, the instrumental ensemble and dancing.
